name: YouTube gallery
description: Shows the latest videos of a YouTube channel or playlist as a grid or a carousel, in posts with [youtube_videos] and as a widget. The list comes from YouTube's public feed (or the Data API with a key) and is refreshed every hour. Thumbnails load from YouTube's image server; the player loads from youtube-nocookie.com only when the visitor presses play. Without JavaScript every video links to YouTube.
author: sap13ns

widgets.title: YouTube videos
widgets.description: The latest videos of a channel or a playlist, as a carousel or a grid.

config.label: Channel
config.help: A channel id (UC…), its URL (youtube.com/channel/UC…) or, with an API key, its handle (@name). Empty uses the plugin settings.

config.label: Playlist
config.help: A playlist id (PL…) or URL. Used instead of the channel when set.

config.label: Number of videos
config.help: 1 to 24 (the feed has the latest 15). Empty uses the plugin settings.

purpose.en: Plays the videos of the YouTube galleries from youtube-nocookie.com. Nothing loads until you press play; then YouTube receives your IP address and may store data on your device.
purpose.es: Reproduce los vídeos de las galerías de YouTube desde youtube-nocookie.com. No se carga nada hasta que pulsas reproducir; entonces YouTube recibe tu dirección IP y puede guardar datos en tu dispositivo.

purpose.en: The galleries' thumbnails load from i.ytimg.com with the page, unless the site turned them off: Google receives your IP address. They set no cookies.
purpose.es: Las miniaturas de las galerías se cargan desde i.ytimg.com con la página, salvo que el sitio las haya desactivado: Google recibe tu dirección IP. No crean cookies.

settings.label: Channel
settings.help: The default channel: its id (UC…), its URL (youtube.com/channel/UC…) or, with an API key, its handle (@name). Find the id on the channel's page: “…more” → “Share channel” → “Copy channel ID”, or for your own channel in YouTube → Settings → Advanced settings.

settings.label: Playlist
settings.help: A default playlist id (PL…) or URL, used instead of the channel when set.

settings.label: Number of videos
settings.help: 1 to 24. The feed has the latest 15 videos; an API key gives up to 24.

settings.label: Layout
settings.help: For [youtube_videos] without layout=. The widget has its own setting.

settings.label: YouTube Data API key
settings.help: Optional. Gives up to 24 videos with durations and live badges, and lets you use handles (@name). Create a key restricted to the YouTube Data API v3 in the Google Cloud console. Each refresh costs 2 to 3 units of the 10,000 free daily units.

settings.label: Show thumbnails
settings.help: Loads each video's thumbnail from i.ytimg.com, so YouTube sees every visitor of the page. Off shows a neutral placeholder and nothing is loaded from YouTube until a video is played.

settings.label: Show the privacy note
settings.help: A short note under each gallery that says what is loaded from YouTube and when.

settings.label: Privacy note
settings.help: Empty uses a built-in note in the page's language (English or Spanish) that matches the thumbnails setting.

settings.label: Privacy policy link
settings.help: https://…, http://… or a site path such as /privacy. Adds a “Privacy policy” link after the note.

settings.label: Privacy policy link for Spanish pages
Privacy policy link for English pages
